description: This file defines type annotations and class interfaces for internal functions related to PyTorch's differentiated functions, including 'UndefinedGrad' and 'DelayedError'.

classes.name: UndefinedGrad
classes.description: A class representing an undefined gradient, capable of being called with tensors to produce a list of tensors.

classes.name: DelayedError
classes.description: A class representing a delayed error message, initialized with a message and number of inputs, with callable behavior defined via overloads.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for UndefinedGrad or DelayedError classes.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Callable method for UndefinedGrad and overloads for DelayedError, performing operations with tensors.
